items.name: page-ui
items.title: NocoBase Files Page UI
items.description: Application-owned Files page that replaces only the Files plugin route component.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-files and provider-ui. The installed extension overrides only FILES_ROUTE_IDS.index; the plugin retains the /files path, route name, auth metadata, and fallback page.

items.name: component-ui
items.title: NocoBase Files Component UI
items.description: V3 controlled upload and preview components for Scoped Files Routes.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-files and provider-ui. FileUploadField and FilePreviewField use StoredFile[] and a relative Scoped Files Route basePath. Form submission validation covers required/minimum, upload state, maxFiles, maxBytes, and accept.

items.name: provider-ui
items.title: NocoBase Files Provider UI
items.description: Shared Files App client Context, Provider, and hook configuration.
items.docs: Provides FilesUiProvider, FilesUiContext, useFilesUi, and usable App-local defaults. It does not declare routes, pages, adapters, or a general plugin framework.
